The bowl measures about 180 px across in the image. If it is a bowl of roughly 15 cm, that gives about 12 px per cm.

The contents are brown and cream curved pieces. They could be sliced or cooked items such as pastry, bread, sliced meat, or a mix of cooked mushrooms and sweet potato. It is hard to identify them. They are a small amount, filling about half the bowl, so I estimate about 80 g.

At roughly 2.5 kcal/g for a mixed food like this, 80 g comes to about 200 kcal.
